department: Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy, PhD and Habilitation Office

deadline.value: No application deadline is given; the PhD registration must be completed within 3 months of starting the doctoral work.
deadline.quote: Registrations must be completed not later than 3 months after starting your PhD undertaking

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: You must find a doctoral supervisor yourself; the online registration is for applicants who already have the supervisor's approval.
supervisor.quote: if you have already received approval from your supervisor at the Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy

funding.value: The chemistry pages do not say how doctoral students are funded.

entry_route.value: Admission needs five years of study in total (3-year bachelor plus 2-year master) with a final grade no worse than 2.50, or a bachelor's through the doctoral aptitude exam (fast-track).
entry_route.quote: Access with doctoral aptitude examination (Fast-track) only Bachelor degree without Master

notes: The faculty's landing page lists the doctoral subjects Inorganic Chemistry, Biochemistry, Didactics of Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry and Theoretical Chemistry among others. Registration with the PhD office is a separate step from the supervisor search.
